description: This file is a Java class implementing the CategoryService interface; it provides operations for managing categories including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and hierarchical management within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of category management logic for an e-commerce platform, handling CRUD operations, hierarchy management, and querying categories based on various attributes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new category and sets its lineage and depth based on its parent.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Returns counts of products associated with specified categories within a store.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories by their codes for a given store and language.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by their IDs for a given store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a category in a specific language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new category or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Returns categories matching a specific lineage.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Returns categories associated with a specific Search Engine Friendly URL.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a category by its SE URL.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a category by its code, either by store or store code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories that are children of a given category.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories belonging to a store and having a specific parent category.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth within a store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories by name within a store and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories in a store; overloaded for language-specific listing.

methods.name: addCategoryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a category.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category and associated products, updating subcategories and handling product-category relationships.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a category in a specific language.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child category under a parent, updating lineage and depth.
